UpdateStageDescription: Writes the bind address, ports and max players into config.yml
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd waterdogpe && if [[ -f config.yml ]]; then sed -i -E -e 's/^(  host: ).*/\1{{$ApplicationIPBinding}}:{{$ServerPort}}/' -e 's/^(  max_players: ).*/\1{{$MaxUsers}}/' -e 's/^(  webrtc_port: ).*/\1{{$WebRTCPort}}/' config.yml; fi"
